title: Remote access exception VPN-2207 (fictional)
text: Kestrel Freight requested remote VPN access to the dispatch system on 2026-07-14. Ines Moreau approved the remote access exception on 2026-07-22. Access is limited to read-only dispatch screens for thirty days.
